proof.declaration: Fix algorithm/precision/representation domain D and one physical shared resource cut. Let W_j be a lower bound on necessary completed work of typed class j during the measured window, after removing duplicate work and granting allowed initial residency once.
proof.capacity_premise: For nonnegative lambda_j, prove for every legal instantaneous allocation/mode/frequency in D that sum_j lambda_j*r_j(t) <= beta(lambda). beta must be a capacity UPPER, not measured best throughput or independent-peak compatibility guess.
derivation: Integrate the capacity inequality over the entire window: integral sum(lambda_j*r_j(t))dt <= T*beta(lambda).
Necessary service is sum_j lambda_j*W_j <= integral sum(lambda_j*r_j(t))dt, including only work proven necessary in D.
Therefore T >= sum_j lambda_j*W_j / beta(lambda). Take the supremum over valid nonnegative weights, and max with other resource/cut/dependency bounds.

Overlapping kernel execution and distributing modes among different AICs do not invalidate an aggregate cut if beta bounds that whole device cut. Initial warm capacity/duplicate work must not be granted once per kernel.
proof.independent_peaks_limit: Knowing Q8<=T*C8 and Qhalf<=T*Chalf alone gives max(Q8/C8,Qhalf/Chalf). It does NOT prove Q8/C8+Qhalf/Chalf<=T; that requires the joint simplex/exclusive-service capacity premise. Do not claim free overlap either.
proof.trivially_safe_but_weak: From valid individual rate upper bounds one may use beta(lambda)=sum(lambda_j*C_j), but this may be weaker than choosing an axis. A tighter beta needs architecture/issue/service proof.
proof.matching_Vector_rule: Exp/Div/Sort/cast/INT64/FP32 classes need their own joint capacity support. A Vector label does not prove serial issue or a common full-rate arithmetic peak.

illustrative_joint_window.domain: Illustrative3validqueries,eachfullQLIscan17408keys andSMLA128SWA+512CMPkeys. Conventional stated exact typed algorithms,not inferred device-visible lengths.
illustrative_joint_window.joint_Cube_bound: T >= [lambda8*427819008 + lambdah*(3342336+251658240)] / beta_Cube(lambda8,lambdah), only if the useful headreduce class is FP16 and beta jointly bounds the selected mixed modes. Native M16 padding belongs to current implementation, not universal necessary work.

relation_to_previous: Refines the max-of-separate-types model with an optional joint support-function capacity cut; no actual joint capacity is invented. Fixed current GM queue volume stays a stated-domain interface model, not an all-algorithm lower bound.
